title: Energy Engineer - Energy Modeling
description:
Sustainable Comfort is looking for an Energy Engineer with experience in whole-building energy modeling, particularly ASHRAE 90.1, to join our expanding team of sustainability professionals. This position will support energy efficiency, building electrification, code compliance, and green building certification projects throughout the Northeast. Our high-growth environment and commitment to best practices provide employees with flexibility and a forward-thinking culture that fosters leadership, creativity, and ingenuity.

Grow both Personally and Professionally. Be a key contributor to developing systems and processes that will support our team for years to come. We offer continuing education, professional development, and training opportunities in energy efficiency, building performance, and green building certifications.

**Essential Duties:**

* Develop baseline and proposed whole-building energy models using eQUEST, OpenStudio/EnergyPlus, IES-VE, Trane TRACE 3D Plus, Carrier HAP, or similar software.
* Perform ASHRAE 90.1 Appendix G performance-based modeling and prepare energy models for IECC compliance, LEED, ENERGY STAR, Passive House, and other green building certification programs.
* Review architectural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and building envelope drawings and specifications to identify energy modeling inputs and opportunities for improved building performance.
* Analyze mechanical systems, including heat pumps, VRF, geothermal, and high-efficiency domestic hot water systems.

* Conduct ASHRAE Level II energy audits and prepare energy savings calculations to evaluate energy conservation measures.
* Support modeling for building decarbonization requirements, stretch energy codes, and local regulations such as NYC Local Law 97 and Boston BERDO.
